text:
Samir Patel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the late-night paging storm. We need an concrete alert-tuning action plan (noise reduction, thresholds, deduping, paging policies). TL;DR: same CPU alerts paged repeatedly during autoscale/rollouts and yesterday's incident looked like a recurring pattern rather than a single regression.

Maria Gomez: Agreed. I sketched 4 candidate actions in the postmortem draft — want to align owners and deadlines so we can close these before next week. :white_check_mark:

Jin Park: Listing them out here so we have a single thread: 1) Reduce sensitivity of Pod CPU alert (threshold + duration). 2) Add dedupe/fingerprint to avoid duplicate pages for the same underlying issue. 3) Route rollout/autoscale noise to non-pager with low severity. 4) Add exponential alert suppression for noisy groups.

Alex Chen: For (1) I propose changing the rule from 70% over 1m to 80% over 5m for non-prod-like namespaces; keep 90%/1m for prod. Example: ```alert: PodCPUHigh expr: sum by(pod)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])) / sum by(pod)(kube_pod_container_resource_limits_cpu_cores) > 0.8 for: 5m labels: severity: warning```

Priya Rao: For (2) we should fingerprint on cluster+node+pod template hash so rolling updates don't create new fingerprints every pod. Suggest annotation: ```fingerprint: "{{ $labels.cluster }}/{{ $labels.pod_template_hash }}"``` That will dedupe spurious duplicates from rolling restarts.

Maria Gomez: For (3) routing idea: any alert with label rollout=true OR namespace=staging -> severity=info, notify Slack channel only, no page. We discussed a drop-in label in the alert manager config.

Jin Park: For (4) suppression: PagerDuty escalation should only trigger on >3 unique fingerprints in 15m or burst >5 pages in 5m. Otherwise send to #eng-oncall-snooze for ops review.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-20260321 created and linked to postmortem (https://redwood/internal/incidents/INC-20260321).

Samir Patel: Okay — owners and deadlines: Maria -> apply alert rule changes and add rollout label mapping (deadline: EOD Fri 2026-03-27). Jin -> update PD escalation & suppression policy + add runbook snippet (deadline: Tue 2026-03-24). Alex -> update dashboards and add a small synthetic to detect noisy patterns (deadline: Wed 2026-03-25). Priya -> implement fingerprint template and test in staging (deadline: Thu 2026-03-26).

Maria Gomez: Confirmed. I'll make the PR with the rule deltas and add unit tests for the alert lines. Will tag everyone for review.

Priya Rao: I'll run a canary in staging tonight and post results here. If dedupe looks good, we can roll to prod next week.

Alex Chen: I'll add the synthetic and a Grafana alert that tracks number of unique fingerprints per 15m window so we can monitor whether dedupe reduces noise.

Jin Park: I'll coordinate with PD team on escalation thresholds. We should also add a paging policy doc blurb: "Only page if severity=critical OR unique_fingerprints>=3 in 15m". Will draft it.

Samir Patel: Follow-up items for postmortem owners (for the PM who asked): I'll update the postmortem action item table with these owners & deadlines and mark this thread as the reference. Please add PR links and test results to the postmortem.

Maria Gomez: Quick note on metrics: we should capture "pages per service per 7d" and a rolling 90th percentile of time-between-pages to detect regressions. I'll add to the dashboard TODOs.

Priya Rao: Can we also add a lightweight alert that watches for "alert churn" (>=10 alerts of any kind from same service in 10m) and route that to #eng-oncall-notify (no page) so SREs can triage before PD is paged?

Jin Park: +1. That can be a severity:info alert with a 0m for visibility only. If it persists (3 occurrences in 1h) escalate to severity:warning and start the paging path.

Samir Patel: Sounds good. Let's reconvene Thursday 11am for a quick sync (15m) to validate staging results and confirm prod rollout schedule. If anyone misses deadlines, ping me directly.

Alex Chen: Adding calendar invite.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: meeting on 2026-03-26 11:00 (15m) — join: https://meet.redwood/alert-tuning-sync

Priya Rao: Posting staging canary results here after the run.

Samir Patel: Thanks all. Goal: reduce pages from this class by >=90% and close these follow-ups in the postmortem before the end of next week. :rocket:
